texts.preamble: Peetu Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2017 Crr-395-2017 (Peetu Yadav Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) 21-02-2017
texts.facts: A perusal of the record reveals that petitioner has been convicted under Section 7 (2) read with Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 6 months and a fine in the sum of Rs.1000/- with default stipulation. It has been submitted on behalf of the petitioner that petitioner was on bail during trial and he has been in jail since 07.02.2017; therefore, it has been prayed that the application be allowed and petitioner be released on bail.
